decisions.choice: Yahweh spoke to Moses: the command for the ordination given in Exodus 29
decisions.reason: Chapters 8-9 carry out what God commanded in Exodus 29:1-37 and 40:12-15: the washing, clothing and anointing of Aaron and his sons and the seven days of their ordination. The account follows those commands step by step, and again and again says that it was done "as Yahweh had commanded Moses".

decisions.choice: the garments: the priestly clothing made in Exodus 28 and 39
decisions.reason: "The garments" are the holy garments God commanded for Aaron and his sons "for glory and for beauty" (Exodus 28:2, 40), made in Exodus 39:1-31. Verses 7-9 and 13 list them.

decisions.choice: the oil of anointing: the holy oil mixed by a set recipe
decisions.reason: This is the sacred oil of Exodus 30:22-33, olive oil blended with myrrh, cinnamon, fragrant cane and cassia. It was used only to anoint the tabernacle, its furnishings and the priests, and no one was to make it for any other use. To anoint was to pour or smear oil on a person or thing to mark it as set apart for God (verses 10-12).

decisions.choice: the two rams and the basket: the offerings of Exodus 29:1-3
decisions.reason: Exodus 29:1-3 names the same animals and the basket of bread. One ram is a burnt offering (verses 18-21) and the other the ram of ordination (verse 22). For the sin offering see 4:3; for unleavened bread see 2:4.

decisions.reason: Readable says whose garments they are. Balanced and Literal keep "the garments", which the reader knows from Exodus 28.

decisions.choice: the tunic, the sash, the robe: the high priest's clothing from the skin out
decisions.reason: The tunic was a long shirt of fine linen worn next to the body (Exodus 28:39); the sash was a woven belt tied around it (Exodus 39:29). Over these went the robe, all of blue, with pomegranates and gold bells around its hem (Exodus 28:31-35). Moses dresses Aaron in the order Exodus 29:5 gives.

decisions.choice: the ephod and its band: the high priest's outer vest and its waistband
decisions.reason: The ephod was the outermost garment of the high priest, made of gold, blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, held by shoulder pieces that carried two onyx stones engraved with the names of the tribes (Exodus 28:6-12). Its band, woven in one piece with it, tied it around the waist. Its exact shape is not described; it seems to have been a kind of vest or apron.

decisions.choice: bound it on him with it: the band fastened the ephod to his body
decisions.reason: The last verb is formed from the word "ephod" itself: he "ephod-ed" him with the band, that is, he fastened the ephod on him by tying the band.

decisions.choice: This was a special vest.
decisions.reason: Readable explains the ephod, a word most readers will not know, in a short added sentence. The comparison to a vest is approximate.

decisions.choice: the breastpiece: a square pouch worn on the chest, set with twelve stones
decisions.reason: Exodus 28:15-30 describes it: a square of the same woven work as the ephod, folded double, set with twelve gems engraved with the names of the tribes, and fastened to the ephod with gold chains and rings. It is called "the breastpiece of judgment" because it held the Urim and Thummim (Exodus 28:15, 30).

decisions.choice: the Urim and the Thummim: objects kept in the breastpiece for seeking God's decision
decisions.reason: Scripture never describes them. They were used to ask God for a decision when Israel needed guidance (Numbers 27:21; Deuteronomy 33:8; 1 Samuel 28:6; Ezra 2:63). The names may mean "lights" and "perfections", but how they were used, perhaps as lots giving a yes or no, is not known. The names are kept as they are.

decisions.choice: These were used to learn what God wanted.
decisions.reason: Readable adds a short explanation of the Urim and Thummim from Numbers 27:21. It says no more than Scripture does about how they worked.

en.B: He set the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban he fixed the gold plate, the holy crown, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: He put the turban on Aaron's head. On the front of the turban he fastened the gold plate. It was the holy crown, the sign that Aaron belonged to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Moses did this just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him.

es.L: Y puso el turbante sobre su cabeza, y puso sobre el turbante, en su parte delantera, la placa de oro, la diadema de santidad, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Colocó el turbante en la cabeza de Aarón, y en la parte delantera del turbante fijó la placa de oro, la diadema santa, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Le puso a Aarón el turbante en la cabeza. En la parte de delante del turbante sujetó la placa de oro. Era la diadema santa, la señal de que Aarón pertenecía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Moisés lo hizo todo tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado.

fr.L: Et il plaça le turban sur sa tête, et il plaça sur le turban, sur le devant, la plaque d’or, le diadème de sainteté, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Il posa le turban sur la tête d’Aaron, et sur le devant du turban il fixa la plaque d’or, le diadème sacré, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Il a mis le turban sur la tête d’Aaron. Sur le devant du turban, il a attaché la plaque d’or. C’était le diadème sacré, le signe qu’Aaron appartenait {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Moïse a fait cela exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait ordonné.

sw.L: Akakiweka kilemba juu ya kichwa chake, akaweka juu ya kilemba, upande wa mbele, bamba la dhahabu, taji ya utakatifu, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Alimvika Haruni kilemba kichwani, na upande wa mbele wa kilemba akafunga bamba la dhahabu, yaani taji takatifu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwagiza Musa.
sw.R: Alimvika Haruni kilemba kichwani. Mbele ya kilemba akafunga bamba la dhahabu. Hiyo ilikuwa taji takatifu, ishara kwamba Haruni ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Musa alifanya hivyo kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru.

decisions.choice: the turban: the high priest's headdress of fine linen
decisions.reason: A head covering wound of fine linen (Exodus 28:39; 39:28), worn only by the high priest. His sons wear a different headdress (verse 13).

decisions.choice: the plate of gold, the crown of holiness: a gold plate engraved "Holy to Yahweh"
decisions.reason: The first word may mean a flower or shining thing; it is the plate of pure gold tied with a blue cord on the front of the turban and engraved "Holy to Yahweh" (Exodus 28:36-38; 39:30-31). It is called a crown, a word for a sign of consecration from the same root as "Nazirite" (Numbers 6:7). It marked Aaron as set apart, bearing the guilt of the holy gifts of Israel (Exodus 28:38).

decisions.choice: the sign that Aaron belonged to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the holy crown" from the words engraved on it in Exodus 28:36.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Moses [the] oil of the anointing and anointed the tabernacle and all that [was] in it and consecrated them.

en.L: And Moses took the oil of anointing and anointed the tabernacle and all that [was] in it, and consecrated them.
en.B: Moses then took the anointing oil. He anointed the tabernacle and all that it held, and consecrated them.
en.R: Then Moses took the anointing oil. He poured some on the tabernacle and everything in it. In this way he set them apart as holy.

es.L: Y tomó Moisés el aceite de la unción, y ungió el tabernáculo y todo lo que [había] en él, y los consagró.
es.B: Después Moisés tomó el aceite de la unción. Ungió el tabernáculo y todo lo que contenía, y así los consagró.
es.R: Luego Moisés tomó el aceite de la unción. Echó un poco sobre el tabernáculo y sobre todo lo que había dentro. Así los apartó como cosas santas.

fr.L: Et Moïse prit l’huile d’onction, et il oignit la Demeure et tout ce qui [était] en elle, et il les consacra.
fr.B: Moïse prit alors l’huile d’onction. Il oignit la Demeure et tout ce qu’elle contenait, et il les consacra.
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse a pris l’huile d’onction. Il en a versé un peu sur le tabernacle et sur tout ce qu’il y avait dedans. Ainsi, il les a mis à part comme des choses saintes.

sw.L: Musa akachukua mafuta ya kupaka, akaipaka mafuta maskani na vyote [vilivyokuwa] ndani yake, akavitakasa.
sw.B: Kisha Musa alichukua mafuta ya kupaka. Akaipaka mafuta maskani na vyote vilivyokuwa ndani yake, akavitakasa.
sw.R: Kisha Musa alichukua mafuta ya kupaka. Akamimina kiasi juu ya maskani na juu ya kila kitu kilichokuwa ndani yake. Kwa njia hiyo akavitenga kuwa vitakatifu.

decisions.choice: consecrated: made holy, set apart for God alone
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something holy: to move it out of common use into God's own possession and service. What is consecrated belongs to God and must be handled as he directs. Holy is not the same as clean: a clean thing is fit for common use, while a holy thing is no longer common at all (10:10). Here the anointing is the act that consecrates the tabernacle, its furnishings, the altar and the priests (verses 11-12, 30; Exodus 29:44; 40:9-13). The same verb is used of God making Israel holy (20:8; 22:32). What God has made holy can be profaned, treated as common (19:8; 22:2).

decisions.choice: anointed the tabernacle: smeared or sprinkled with the holy oil
decisions.reason: The tabernacle is the dwelling, the tent itself with its frames and curtains (Exodus 26). Anointing it and its furnishings was commanded in Exodus 30:26-29 and 40:9-11, which says that they become most holy and make holy whatever touches them.

decisions.choice: set them apart as holy
decisions.reason: Readable explains "consecrate", a word many readers do not use, as "set apart as holy". Literal and Balanced keep "consecrate". The same wording is used wherever this verb means making a thing or person holy.

decisions.choice: poured some on
decisions.reason: Readable describes what anointing was, putting oil on a thing. Literal and Balanced keep "anointed".

source.text: וַיַּ֥ז מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֗יו וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֛ר וְאֶת־כַּנּ֖וֹ לְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and anointed the altar and all its utensils and the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.

en.L: And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.
en.B: He sprinkled some of the oil seven times on the altar, and anointed the altar with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.
en.R: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times. He anointed the altar and all the tools used with it. He also anointed the large bowl for washing and its stand. He did this to set them apart as holy.

es.L: Y roció de él sobre el altar siete veces, y ungió el altar y todos sus utensilios, y la pila y su base, para consagrarlos.
es.B: Roció siete veces un poco del aceite sobre el altar, y ungió el altar con todos sus utensilios, y la pila con su base, para consagrarlos.
es.R: Roció un poco del aceite sobre el altar siete veces. Ungió el altar y todas las herramientas que se usaban con él. También ungió la pila grande para lavarse y su base. Lo hizo para apartarlos como cosas santas.

fr.L: Et il en aspergea l’autel sept fois, et il oignit l’autel et tous ses ustensiles, et la cuve et son support, pour les consacrer.
fr.B: Il aspergea sept fois l’autel d’un peu d’huile, et il oignit l’autel avec tous ses ustensiles, ainsi que la cuve avec son support, pour les consacrer.
fr.R: Il a aspergé l’autel d’huile sept fois. Il a oint l’autel et tous les objets qui servent avec lui. Il a aussi oint la grande cuve où l’on se lave, et son support. Il a fait cela pour les mettre à part comme des choses saintes.

sw.L: Akanyunyiza baadhi yake juu ya madhabahu mara saba, akaipaka mafuta madhabahu na vyombo vyake vyote, na birika na kiweko chake, ili kuvitakasa.
sw.B: Alinyunyiza mafuta kidogo juu ya madhabahu mara saba, akaipaka mafuta madhabahu pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, na birika pamoja na kiweko chake, ili kuvitakasa.
sw.R: Alinyunyiza mafuta kidogo juu ya madhabahu mara saba. Akaipaka mafuta madhabahu na vyombo vyote vinavyotumika nayo. Akapaka pia mafuta birika kubwa la kunawia na kiweko chake. Alifanya hivyo ili kuvitenga kuwa vitakatifu.

decisions.choice: sprinkled seven times: spattered drops of oil, seven being a number of completeness
decisions.reason: This verb means to spatter in small drops (4:6), not to throw or splash. Seven sprinklings mark the act as full and complete, as with blood in 4:6 and 16:14, 19. Exodus 29:36-37 commands that the altar be made holy over seven days.

decisions.choice: the altar ... the basin and its stand: the bronze altar of burnt offering and the bronze basin
decisions.reason: The altar is the altar of burnt offering in the courtyard (Exodus 27:1-8); its utensils are its pots, shovels, basins, forks and fire pans (Exodus 27:3). The basin stood between the tent and the altar and held water for the priests' washing (Exodus 30:17-21). Consecrate: see verse 10.

decisions.choice: the large bowl for washing
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the basin was for, as Exodus 30:18-19 says.

source.text: וַיִּצֹק֙ מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And poured some of [the] oil of the anointing on [the] head of Aaron and anointed him to consecrate him.

en.L: And he poured some of the oil of anointing on Aaron's head and anointed him, to consecrate him.
en.B: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head, anointing him to consecrate him.
en.R: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head. He anointed him to set him apart as holy.

es.L: Y derramó del aceite de la unción sobre la cabeza de Aarón, y lo ungió para consagrarlo.
es.B: Derramó un poco del aceite de la unción sobre la cabeza de Aarón; así lo ungió para consagrarlo.
es.R: Echó un poco del aceite de la unción sobre la cabeza de Aarón. Lo ungió para apartarlo como santo.

fr.L: Et il versa de l’huile d’onction sur la tête d’Aaron, et il l’oignit pour le consacrer.
fr.B: Il versa un peu de l’huile d’onction sur la tête d’Aaron ; il l’oignit ainsi pour le consacrer.
fr.R: Il a versé un peu d’huile d’onction sur la tête d’Aaron. Il l’a oint pour le mettre à part comme saint.

sw.L: Akamimina baadhi ya mafuta ya kupaka juu ya kichwa cha Haruni, akampaka mafuta ili kumtakasa.
sw.B: Alimimina mafuta kidogo ya kupaka juu ya kichwa cha Haruni, akampaka mafuta ili kumtakasa.
sw.R: Alimimina kiasi cha mafuta ya kupaka juu ya kichwa cha Haruni. Akampaka mafuta ili kumtenga kuwa mtakatifu.

decisions.choice: poured on Aaron's head: Aaron is anointed as high priest
decisions.reason: Oil is poured on Aaron's head, not only sprinkled. Exodus 29:7 commanded this, and Psalm 133:2 remembers the oil running down on Aaron's beard and collar. Aaron becomes "the anointed priest" (4:3, 5, 16; 6:15). His sons are sprinkled with oil and blood later (verse 30; Exodus 29:21).

source.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁ֤ם כֻּתֳּנֹת֙ וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ אַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּחֲבֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם מִגְבָּע֑וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought near Moses [the] sons of Aaron and clothed them [with] tunics and girded them [with] a sash and bound on them caps, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And Moses brought Aaron's sons near and clothed them [with] tunics, and tied sashes around them, and bound caps on them, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Then Moses had Aaron's sons come forward. He dressed them in tunics, tied sashes around their waists, and fastened caps on their heads, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: Next Moses brought Aaron's sons forward. He put tunics on them and tied sashes around their waists. He put caps on their heads. He did it just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him.

es.L: E hizo acercarse Moisés a los hijos de Aarón, y los vistió [con] túnicas, y les ciñó fajas, y les ató gorros, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Luego Moisés hizo que se acercaran los hijos de Aarón. Los vistió con túnicas, les ató fajas a la cintura y les puso gorros en la cabeza, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Después Moisés trajo a los hijos de Aarón. Les puso túnicas y les ató fajas a la cintura. Les puso gorros en la cabeza. Lo hizo tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado.

fr.L: Et Moïse fit approcher les fils d’Aaron, et il les revêtit de tuniques, et il leur noua des ceintures, et il leur attacha des bonnets, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Moïse fit ensuite avancer les fils d’Aaron. Il les revêtit de tuniques, leur noua des ceintures autour de la taille et leur ajusta des bonnets sur la tête, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse a fait venir les fils d’Aaron. Il leur a mis des tuniques et leur a noué des ceintures autour de la taille. Il leur a mis des bonnets sur la tête. Il a fait cela comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait ordonné.

sw.L: Musa akawasogeza wana wa Haruni, akawavika kanzu, akawafunga mishipi, akawafungia kofia, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Kisha Musa aliwaleta wana wa Haruni mbele. Akawavika kanzu, akawafunga mishipi viunoni, na kuwavika kofia vichwani, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwagiza Musa.
sw.R: Kisha Musa aliwaleta wana wa Haruni. Akawavika kanzu na kuwafunga mishipi viunoni. Akawavika kofia vichwani. Alifanya hivyo kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru.

decisions.choice: tunics, sashes and caps: the clothing of the ordinary priests
decisions.reason: Aaron's sons wear the simpler garments of Exodus 28:40-43, made "for glory and for beauty": a linen tunic, a sash and a headdress. The word for their headdress differs from Aaron's turban (verse 9); it may describe a rounded cap or a band wound around the head (Exodus 39:28).

decisions.choice: sashes
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the singular "a sash", meaning one for each son. English says "sashes". In Literal the plural needs no bracket, since no word is added.

source.text: וַיַּגֵּ֕שׁ אֵ֖ת פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וַיִּסְמֹ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־רֹ֖אשׁ פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought near the bull of the sin offering, and leaned Aaron and his sons their hands on [the] head of [the] bull of the sin offering.

en.L: And he brought near the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons leaned their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
en.B: He led up the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
en.R: Then Moses brought the bull for the sin offering. Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

es.L: Y acercó el novillo del sacrificio por el pecado, y Aarón y sus hijos apoyaron sus manos sobre la cabeza del novillo del sacrificio por el pecado.
es.B: Hizo traer el novillo para el sacrificio por el pecado, y Aarón y sus hijos pusieron las manos sobre su cabeza.
es.R: Luego Moisés trajo el novillo para el sacrificio por el pecado. Aarón y sus hijos pusieron las manos sobre su cabeza.

fr.L: Et il fit approcher le taureau du sacrifice pour le péché, et Aaron et ses fils appuyèrent leurs mains sur la tête du taureau du sacrifice pour le péché.
fr.B: Il amena le taureau du sacrifice pour le péché, et Aaron et ses fils posèrent les mains sur sa tête.
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse a amené le taureau du sacrifice pour le péché. Aaron et ses fils ont mis leurs mains sur sa tête.

sw.L: Akamsogeza fahali wa sadaka ya dhambi, na Haruni na wanawe wakaegemeza mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha fahali wa sadaka ya dhambi.
sw.B: Alimleta fahali wa sadaka ya dhambi, na Haruni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
sw.R: Kisha Musa alimleta fahali wa sadaka ya dhambi. Haruni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

decisions.choice: leaned their hands on the head: Aaron and his sons make the offering their own
decisions.reason: As in 1:4 and 4:4, leaning the hand on the animal marks it as the offering of the one who brings it. Here the new priests offer first for themselves: before they can make atonement for others, atonement is made for them (verse 34; 9:7; Hebrews 7:27). For the sin offering see 4:3.

decisions.choice: its head
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "its head" rather than repeat "the bull of the sin offering".

source.text: וַיִּשְׁחָ֗ט וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־הַדָּם֙ וַ֠יִּתֵּן עַל־קַרְנ֨וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ סָבִיב֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וַיְחַטֵּ֖א אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־הַדָּ֗ם יָצַק֙ אֶל־יְס֣וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֖הוּ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And slaughtered [it], and took Moses the blood and put [it] on [the] horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar, and the blood poured out at [the] base of the altar, and consecrated it to make atonement on it.

en.L: And he slaughtered [it], and Moses took the blood and put [it] on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar; and the blood he poured out at the base of the altar, and he consecrated it, to make atonement for it.
en.B: Moses slaughtered it, took the blood, and with his finger put some on each of the horns of the altar all around, purifying the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it, to make atonement for it.
en.R: Moses killed the bull. He took its blood and used his finger to put some on all the horns at the corners of the altar. In this way he made the altar pure. He poured out the rest of the blood at the bottom of the altar. So he set the altar apart as holy and made atonement for it.

es.L: Y [lo] degolló, y tomó Moisés la sangre, y [la] puso sobre los cuernos del altar, alrededor, con su dedo, y purificó el altar; y la sangre la derramó al pie del altar, y lo consagró para hacer expiación por él.
es.B: Moisés lo degolló, tomó la sangre y con el dedo puso un poco en cada uno de los cuernos del altar, alrededor, y así purificó el altar. Derramó el resto de la sangre al pie del altar. Así lo consagró, para hacer expiación por él.
es.R: Moisés mató el novillo. Tomó su sangre y con el dedo puso un poco en todos los cuernos de las esquinas del altar. Así purificó el altar. Echó el resto de la sangre en la parte de abajo del altar. De este modo apartó el altar como santo e hizo expiación por él.

fr.L: Et il [l’]égorgea, et Moïse prit le sang, et il [le] mit sur les cornes de l’autel, tout autour, avec son doigt, et il purifia l’autel ; et le sang, il le répandit au pied de l’autel, et il le consacra pour faire l’expiation pour lui.
fr.B: Moïse l’égorgea, prit le sang et, avec son doigt, en mit sur chacune des cornes de l’autel, tout autour ; il purifia ainsi l’autel. Il répandit le reste du sang au pied de l’autel. Ainsi il le consacra, pour faire l’expiation pour lui.
fr.R: Moïse a tué le taureau. Il a pris son sang et, avec son doigt, il en a mis sur toutes les cornes aux coins de l’autel. Ainsi, il a rendu l’autel pur. Il a versé le reste du sang en bas de l’autel. De cette façon, il a mis l’autel à part comme saint et il a fait l’expiation pour lui.

sw.L: Akamchinja, na Musa akaichukua damu, akaitia juu ya pembe za madhabahu pande zote kwa kidole chake, akaisafisha madhabahu; na damu akaimwaga chini ya madhabahu, akaitakasa ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake.
sw.B: Musa alimchinja, akachukua damu, na kwa kidole chake akaitia kwenye kila pembe ya madhabahu pande zote, akaisafisha madhabahu. Damu iliyobaki akaimwaga chini ya madhabahu. Hivyo akaitakasa, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake.
sw.R: Musa alimchinja fahali. Akachukua damu yake, na kwa kidole chake akaitia kwenye pembe zote zilizo kwenye kona za madhabahu. Kwa njia hiyo akaifanya madhabahu kuwa safi. Damu iliyobaki akaimwaga chini ya madhabahu. Hivyo akaitenga madhabahu kuwa takatifu na kuifanyia upatanisho.

decisions.choice: slaughtered: most likely Moses, named with the next verb
decisions.reason: The first verb has no stated subject; Moses is named with the second. Exodus 29:10-11 tells Moses to slaughter the bull, so Moses is most likely the subject of both. The same pattern recurs in verses 19 and 23.

decisions.choice: purified the altar: cleansed it from sin's defilement
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the same root as "sin offering". It means to remove the stain of sin, to purify. The blood of the sin offering cleanses the altar, as in Exodus 29:36-37, so that it can be holy and used for atonement. See the note on the sin offering at 4:3.

decisions.choice: to make atonement for it: for the altar itself
decisions.reason: "On it" here means for the altar, which is cleansed and consecrated so that atonement can be made on it from now on (Exodus 29:36-37). For atonement see 1:4; for the horns and the base see 4:7.

decisions.choice: all the horns at the corners of the altar
decisions.reason: Readable explains that the horns stood at the altar's four corners (Exodus 27:2).

decisions.choice: "akaisafisha" (purified, from the root of the sin offering); "akaitakasa" (consecrated, L, B), "akaitenga kuwa takatifu" (R)
decisions.reason: Swahili "kutakasa" can mean both to purify and to make holy. Here the two Hebrew verbs stand side by side, so the cleansing from sin is "kusafisha" and the consecration keeps "kutakasa", as the rest of the chapter does.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֗ח אֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And took all the fat which [was] on the entrails and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and made [them] smoke Moses on the altar.

en.L: And he took all the fat that [was] on the entrails, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses turned [them] into smoke on the altar.
en.B: He took all the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with their fat, and Moses burned them on the altar.
en.R: He took all the fat on the inner parts, the best part of the liver, and both kidneys with their fat. Moses burned all of it on the altar.

es.L: Y tomó toda la grasa que [estaba] sobre las entrañas, y el apéndice del hígado, y los dos riñones y su grasa, e hizo humear [todo] Moisés sobre el altar.
es.B: Tomó toda la grasa que cubría las vísceras, el lóbulo largo del hígado y los dos riñones con su grasa, y Moisés los hizo subir en humo sobre el altar.
es.R: Tomó toda la grasa que había sobre los órganos internos, la mejor parte del hígado y los dos riñones con su grasa. Moisés lo quemó todo en el altar.

fr.L: Et il prit toute la graisse qui [était] sur les entrailles, et l’appendice du foie, et les deux rognons et leur graisse, et Moïse [les] fit fumer sur l’autel.
fr.B: Il prit toute la graisse qui était sur les viscères, le grand lobe du foie et les deux rognons avec leur graisse, et Moïse les fit monter en fumée sur l’autel.
fr.R: Il a pris toute la graisse qui était sur les organes du ventre, la meilleure partie du foie et les deux rognons avec leur graisse. Moïse a tout brûlé sur l’autel.

sw.L: Akaichukua shahamu yote iliyokuwa juu ya matumbo, na kipande kinachojitokeza cha ini, na figo mbili na shahamu yake, na Musa [akavi]fukiza juu ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Alichukua shahamu yote iliyokuwa juu ya viungo vya ndani, kipande kirefu cha ini, na figo mbili pamoja na shahamu yake, na Musa akavifukiza juu ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Alichukua shahamu yote iliyokuwa juu ya viungo vya ndani, sehemu bora ya ini, na figo mbili pamoja na shahamu yake. Musa akavichoma vyote juu ya madhabahu.

decisions.choice: the fat, the lobe of the liver, the kidneys: the parts that belong to Yahweh
decisions.reason: These are the parts of every sin offering and peace offering that are burned on the altar (3:3-4; 4:8-9). See the notes at 3:3 and 3:4.

decisions.choice: turned into smoke: burned on the altar so that it rose as smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke. It is used for burning offerings on the altar (1:9).

source.text: וְאֶת־הַפָּ֤ר וְאֶת־עֹרוֹ֙ וְאֶת־בְּשָׂר֣וֹ וְאֶת־פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the bull and its hide and its flesh and its dung he burned with fire outside the camp, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And the bull, and its hide and its flesh and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: But the bull, with its hide, its meat and its dung, he burned up outside the camp, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: But he burned the rest of the bull outside the camp. He burned its skin, its meat and its dung, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him.

es.L: Y el novillo, y su piel y su carne y su estiércol, los quemó al fuego fuera del campamento, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Pero el novillo, con su piel, su carne y su estiércol, lo quemó por completo fuera del campamento, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Pero quemó el resto del novillo fuera del campamento. Quemó su piel, su carne y su estiércol, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado.

fr.L: Et le taureau, et sa peau, et sa chair, et ses excréments, il les brûla au feu hors du camp, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Mais le taureau, avec sa peau, sa viande et ses excréments, il le brûla entièrement hors du camp, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Mais il a brûlé le reste du taureau hors du camp. Il a brûlé sa peau, sa viande et ses excréments, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait ordonné.

sw.L: Na fahali, na ngozi yake na nyama yake na mavi yake, akaviteketeza kwa moto nje ya kambi, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Lakini fahali, pamoja na ngozi yake, nyama yake na mavi yake, akaviteketeza kabisa kwa moto nje ya kambi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwagiza Musa.
sw.R: Lakini sehemu iliyobaki ya fahali aliichoma nje ya kambi. Aliichoma ngozi yake, nyama yake na mavi yake, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru.

decisions.choice: burned outside the camp: the sin offering for the priests is not eaten
decisions.reason: As Exodus 29:14 commands and 4:11-12 rules for a priest's sin offering, the rest of the bull is burned outside the camp. A sin offering whose blood is brought for the priest himself may not be eaten by the priests (6:23). Hebrews 13:11-12 recalls this burning outside the camp.

source.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת אֵ֣יל הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: And presented the ram of the burnt offering, and leaned Aaron and his sons their hands on [the] head of the ram.

en.L: And he presented the ram of the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons leaned their hands on the head of the ram.
en.B: Then he brought forward the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
en.R: Then he brought the ram for the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

es.L: Y presentó el carnero del holocausto, y Aarón y sus hijos apoyaron sus manos sobre la cabeza del carnero.
es.B: Después hizo traer el carnero para el holocausto, y Aarón y sus hijos pusieron las manos sobre su cabeza.
es.R: Luego trajo el carnero para el holocausto. Aarón y sus hijos pusieron las manos sobre su cabeza.

fr.L: Et il présenta le bélier de l’holocauste, et Aaron et ses fils appuyèrent leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
fr.B: Puis il amena le bélier de l’holocauste, et Aaron et ses fils posèrent les mains sur sa tête.
fr.R: Puis il a amené le bélier de l’holocauste. Aaron et ses fils ont mis leurs mains sur sa tête.

sw.L: Akamleta karibu kondoo dume wa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na Haruni na wanawe wakaegemeza mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha kondoo dume.
sw.B: Kisha alimleta kondoo dume wa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na Haruni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
sw.R: Kisha alimleta kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Haruni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

decisions.choice: the ram of the burnt offering: the first of the two rams
decisions.reason: Exodus 29:15-18 commands this ram as a burnt offering, wholly burned on the altar. For the burnt offering see 1:3; for leaning the hands see 1:4.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁחָ֑ט וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And slaughtered [it], and threw Moses the blood on the altar all around.

en.L: And he slaughtered [it], and Moses threw the blood against the altar all around.
en.B: Moses slaughtered it and splashed the blood against all sides of the altar.
en.R: Moses killed the ram and splashed its blood on all sides of the altar.

es.L: Y [lo] degolló, y arrojó Moisés la sangre contra el altar, alrededor.
es.B: Moisés lo degolló y salpicó la sangre por todos los lados del altar.
es.R: Moisés mató el carnero y salpicó su sangre por todos los lados del altar.

fr.L: Et il [l’]égorgea, et Moïse jeta le sang contre l’autel, tout autour.
fr.B: Moïse l’égorgea et projeta le sang sur tous les côtés de l’autel.
fr.R: Moïse a tué le bélier et il a projeté son sang sur tous les côtés de l’autel.

sw.L: Akamchinja, na Musa akairusha damu kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.B: Musa alimchinja, akairusha damu kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.R: Musa alimchinja kondoo dume, akarusha damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.

decisions.choice: threw the blood against the altar all around
decisions.reason: The blood is thrown from a bowl against the sides of the altar, as in 1:5. For the unnamed subject of "slaughtered" see verse 15.

source.text: וְאֶת־הָאַ֔יִל נִתַּ֖ח לִנְתָחָ֑יו וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־הַנְּתָחִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַפָּֽדֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the ram he cut into its pieces, and made smoke Moses the head and the pieces and the suet.

en.L: And the ram he cut into its pieces, and Moses turned the head and the pieces and the suet into smoke.
en.B: He cut the ram into its pieces, and Moses burned the head, the pieces and the fat.
en.R: He cut the ram into pieces. Moses burned the head, the pieces and the fat.

es.L: Y el carnero lo cortó en sus piezas, e hizo humear Moisés la cabeza, y las piezas, y el sebo.
es.B: Cortó el carnero en piezas, y Moisés hizo subir en humo la cabeza, las piezas y el sebo.
es.R: Cortó el carnero en pedazos. Moisés quemó la cabeza, los pedazos y la grasa.

fr.L: Et le bélier, il le coupa en ses morceaux, et Moïse fit fumer la tête, et les morceaux, et le suif.
fr.B: Il découpa le bélier en morceaux, et Moïse fit monter en fumée la tête, les morceaux et le suif.
fr.R: Il a découpé le bélier en morceaux. Moïse a brûlé la tête, les morceaux et la graisse.

sw.L: Na kondoo dume akamkata vipande vyake, na Musa akakifukiza kichwa, na vipande, na shahamu.
sw.B: Alimkata kondoo dume vipande vipande, na Musa akakifukiza kichwa, vipande na shahamu.
sw.R: Alimkata kondoo dume vipande. Musa akachoma kichwa, vipande na shahamu.

decisions.choice: the suet: the hard fat of the animal
decisions.reason: This word for fat appears only here, in verse 20, and in 1:8 and 1:12. It seems to mean the firm fat around the kidneys and loins, the suet.

source.text: וְאֶת־הַקֶּ֥רֶב וְאֶת־הַכְּרָעַ֖יִם רָחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵר֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת־כָּל־הָאַ֜יִל הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חָה עֹלָ֨ה ה֤וּא לְרֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ אִשֶּׁ֥ה הוּא֙ לַיהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the entrails and the legs he washed with water, and made smoke Moses all the ram on the altar; a burnt offering it [was], for an aroma of soothing, an offering by fire it [was] to Yahweh, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And the entrails and the legs he washed with water, and Moses turned the whole ram into smoke on the altar. It [was] a burnt offering for an aroma of soothing; it [was] an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: He washed the internal organs and the legs in water, and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering with a soothing aroma, a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: He washed the inner parts and the legs with water. Then Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering. Its smell pleased {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It was a food offering burned on the fire for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Moses did just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him.

es.L: Y las entrañas y las patas las lavó con agua, e hizo humear Moisés todo el carnero sobre el altar. [Era] un holocausto de aroma grato; [era] una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Lavó con agua las vísceras y las patas, y Moisés hizo subir en humo todo el carnero sobre el altar. Fue un holocausto de aroma grato, una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Lavó con agua los órganos internos y las patas. Después Moisés quemó todo el carnero en el altar. Era un holocausto. Su olor fue agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Era una ofrenda quemada en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Moisés hizo tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado.

fr.L: Et les entrailles et les pattes, il les lava avec de l’eau, et Moïse fit fumer tout le bélier sur l’autel. C’[était] un holocauste d’odeur apaisante ; c’[était] une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Il lava dans l’eau les viscères et les pattes, et Moïse fit monter en fumée tout le bélier sur l’autel. Ce fut un holocauste d’odeur apaisante, une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Il a lavé avec de l’eau les organes du ventre et les pattes. Puis Moïse a brûlé tout le bélier sur l’autel. C’était un holocauste. Son odeur a plu {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. C’était une offrande brûlée sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Moïse a fait exactement ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait ordonné.

sw.L: Na matumbo na miguu akaviosha kwa maji, na Musa akamfukiza kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. [Ilikuwa] sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya harufu ya kupendeza; [ilikuwa] sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Aliviosha kwa maji viungo vya ndani na miguu, na Musa akamfukiza kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. Ilikuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa yenye harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwagiza Musa.
sw.R: Aliviosha kwa maji viungo vya ndani na miguu. Kisha Musa akamchoma kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. Ilikuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Harufu yake ilimpendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ilikuwa sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Musa alifanya kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru.

decisions.choice: the whole ram ... a burnt offering: the ram is wholly given to Yahweh
decisions.reason: As with every burnt offering (1:9), the whole animal is burned. The words follow Exodus 29:18. For "soothing aroma" and "offering by fire" see 1:9.

source.text: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת־הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: And presented the ram the second, [the] ram of the ordination, and leaned Aaron and his sons their hands on [the] head of the ram.

en.L: And he presented the second ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons leaned their hands on the head of the ram.
en.B: Next he brought forward the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
en.R: Next he brought the second ram. It was the ram for ordaining the priests. Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

es.L: Y presentó el segundo carnero, el carnero de la investidura, y Aarón y sus hijos apoyaron sus manos sobre la cabeza del carnero.
es.B: Luego hizo traer el otro carnero, el carnero de la investidura, y Aarón y sus hijos pusieron las manos sobre su cabeza.
es.R: Después trajo el segundo carnero. Era el carnero para investir a los sacerdotes. Aarón y sus hijos pusieron las manos sobre su cabeza.

fr.L: Et il présenta le second bélier, le bélier de l’investiture, et Aaron et ses fils appuyèrent leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
fr.B: Il amena ensuite l’autre bélier, le bélier de l’investiture, et Aaron et ses fils posèrent les mains sur sa tête.
fr.R: Ensuite, il a amené le deuxième bélier. C’était le bélier pour investir les prêtres. Aaron et ses fils ont mis leurs mains sur sa tête.

sw.L: Akamleta karibu kondoo dume wa pili, kondoo dume wa kusimikwa, na Haruni na wanawe wakaegemeza mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha kondoo dume.
sw.B: Kisha alimleta kondoo dume yule mwingine, kondoo dume wa kusimikwa, na Haruni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
sw.R: Kisha alimleta kondoo dume wa pili. Huyo alikuwa kondoo dume wa kuwasimika makuhani. Haruni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

decisions.choice: the ram of ordination: literally "the ram of the fillings"
decisions.reason: The word means "fillings". It comes from the idiom "to fill the hand", used for installing someone as a priest (verse 33; Exodus 28:41; 29:9; Judges 17:5, 12). The idiom may come from putting parts of the offering into the priests' hands, as Moses does in verses 26-28, or from giving a man his priestly share and right to serve. This ram and its offering complete the priests' installation. Its rite is commanded in Exodus 29:19-34.

decisions.choice: ordination (Literal, Balanced); ordaining the priests (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Ordination" names what the offering does: it installs Aaron and his sons as priests. "Filling" would hide the meaning, so all three levels say "ordination", and Literal keeps the idiom where the verb "fill" itself appears (verse 33). Readable says what is being done and for whom.

decisions.choice: "el carnero de la investidura" (L, B); "para investir a los sacerdotes" (R)
decisions.reason: The English keeps "ordination" at every level here, so Spanish uses "investidura" even at Literal; the idiom "llenar la mano" is kept where the verb itself appears (verse 33).

decisions.choice: "le bélier de l'investiture" (L, B); "pour investir les prêtres" (R)
decisions.reason: The English keeps "ordination" at every level here, so French uses "investiture" even at Literal; the idiom "remplir la main" is kept where the verb itself appears (verse 33).

decisions.choice: "kondoo dume wa kusimikwa" (L, B); "wa kuwasimika makuhani" (R)
decisions.reason: The English keeps "ordination" at every level here, so Swahili uses "kusimikwa" even at Literal; the idiom "kujaza mkono" is kept where the verb itself appears (verse 33).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁחָ֓ט׀וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִדָּמ֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֛ן עַל־תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And slaughtered [it], and took Moses some of its blood and put [it] on [the] lobe of [the] ear of Aaron the right and on [the] thumb of his hand the right and on [the] big toe of his foot the right.

en.L: And he slaughtered [it], and Moses took some of its blood and put [it] on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
en.B: Moses slaughtered it and took some of its blood. He put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
en.R: Moses killed the ram and took some of its blood. He put it on Aaron's right earlobe, on his right thumb and on the big toe of his right foot.

es.L: Y [lo] degolló, y tomó Moisés de su sangre, y [la] puso sobre el lóbulo de la oreja derecha de Aarón, y sobre el pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el dedo gordo de su pie derecho.
es.B: Moisés lo degolló y tomó un poco de su sangre. La puso en el lóbulo de la oreja derecha de Aarón, en el pulgar de su mano derecha y en el dedo gordo de su pie derecho.
es.R: Moisés mató el carnero y tomó un poco de su sangre. La puso en la parte de abajo de la oreja derecha de Aarón, en su pulgar derecho y en el dedo gordo de su pie derecho.

fr.L: Et il [l’]égorgea, et Moïse prit de son sang, et il [le] mit sur le lobe de l’oreille droite d’Aaron, et sur le pouce de sa main droite, et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit.
fr.B: Moïse l’égorgea et prit un peu de son sang. Il en mit sur le lobe de l’oreille droite d’Aaron, sur le pouce de sa main droite et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit.
fr.R: Moïse a tué le bélier et a pris un peu de son sang. Il en a mis sur le bas de l’oreille droite d’Aaron, sur son pouce droit et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit.

sw.L: Akamchinja, na Musa akachukua sehemu ya damu yake, akaitia juu ya ndewe ya sikio la kulia la Haruni, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kulia, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mguu wake wa kulia.
sw.B: Musa alimchinja, akachukua sehemu ya damu yake. Akaitia kwenye ndewe ya sikio la kulia la Haruni, kwenye kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kulia na kwenye kidole gumba cha mguu wake wa kulia.
sw.R: Musa alimchinja kondoo dume, akachukua damu yake kidogo. Akaitia chini ya sikio la kulia la Haruni, kwenye kidole gumba chake cha kulia na kwenye kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kulia.

decisions.choice: ear, thumb, big toe: the whole person set apart for God's service
decisions.reason: The blood is put on the extremities of the right side of the body, as Exodus 29:20 commands. The rite seems to mark the whole person, from head to foot, as cleansed and set apart. Some see the ear as hearing God's word, the hand as doing his work, and the foot as walking in his ways, but the text does not explain it. The same rite cleanses a person healed of skin disease (14:14, 17, 25, 28).

source.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֤ה מִן־הַדָּם֙ עַל־תְּנ֤וּךְ אָזְנָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַֽמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought near [the] sons of Aaron, and put Moses some of the blood on [the] lobe of their ear the right and on [the] thumb of their hand the right and on [the] big toe of their foot the right, and threw Moses the blood on the altar all around.

en.L: And he brought Aaron's sons near, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobe of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and Moses threw the blood against the altar all around.
en.B: Then he had Aaron's sons come forward, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. And Moses splashed the blood against all sides of the altar.
en.R: Then Moses brought Aaron's sons forward. He put some of the blood on each one's right earlobe, right thumb and the big toe of the right foot. Then Moses splashed the rest of the blood on all sides of the altar.

es.L: E hizo acercarse a los hijos de Aarón, y puso Moisés de la sangre sobre el lóbulo de su oreja derecha, y sobre el pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el dedo gordo de su pie derecho; y arrojó Moisés la sangre contra el altar, alrededor.
es.B: Luego hizo que se acercaran los hijos de Aarón, y Moisés puso un poco de la sangre en los lóbulos de sus orejas derechas, en los pulgares de sus manos derechas y en los dedos gordos de sus pies derechos. Y Moisés salpicó la sangre por todos los lados del altar.
es.R: Después Moisés trajo a los hijos de Aarón. Puso un poco de la sangre en la parte de abajo de la oreja derecha de cada uno, en su pulgar derecho y en el dedo gordo de su pie derecho. Luego Moisés salpicó el resto de la sangre por todos los lados del altar.

fr.L: Et il fit approcher les fils d’Aaron, et Moïse mit du sang sur le lobe de leur oreille droite, et sur le pouce de leur main droite, et sur le gros orteil de leur pied droit ; et Moïse jeta le sang contre l’autel, tout autour.
fr.B: Puis il fit avancer les fils d’Aaron, et Moïse mit un peu de sang sur le lobe de leurs oreilles droites, sur le pouce de leurs mains droites et sur le gros orteil de leurs pieds droits. Et Moïse projeta le sang sur tous les côtés de l’autel.
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse a fait venir les fils d’Aaron. Il a mis un peu de sang sur le bas de l’oreille droite de chacun, sur son pouce droit et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit. Puis Moïse a projeté le reste du sang sur tous les côtés de l’autel.

sw.L: Akawasogeza wana wa Haruni, na Musa akatia sehemu ya damu juu ya ndewe ya sikio lao la kulia, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mkono wao wa kulia, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mguu wao wa kulia; na Musa akairusha damu kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.B: Kisha aliwaleta wana wa Haruni mbele, na Musa akatia sehemu ya damu kwenye ndewe za masikio yao ya kulia, kwenye vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kulia na kwenye vidole gumba vya miguu yao ya kulia. Kisha Musa akairusha damu kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.R: Kisha Musa aliwaleta wana wa Haruni. Akatia damu kidogo chini ya sikio la kulia la kila mmoja wao, kwenye kidole gumba chake cha kulia na kwenye kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kulia. Kisha Musa akarusha damu iliyobaki pande zote za madhabahu.

decisions.choice: their ear, their hand, their foot: each son's
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the singular with "their": the right ear, hand and foot of each son. The rite is the same as Aaron's in verse 23.

decisions.choice: lobes ... thumbs ... big toes
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the plural for the several sons; Literal keeps the singular.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב וְאֶת־הָֽאַלְיָ֗ה וְאֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: And took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat which [was] on the entrails and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat and the thigh the right.

en.L: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that [was] on the entrails, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh.
en.B: He took the fat: the fat tail, all the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys with their fat, and also the right thigh.
en.R: He took the fat parts. There was the fat tail, all the fat on the inner parts, the best part of the liver, and both kidneys with their fat. He also took the right thigh.

es.L: Y tomó la grasa, y la cola grasa, y toda la grasa que [estaba] sobre las entrañas, y el apéndice del hígado, y los dos riñones y su grasa, y el muslo derecho.
es.B: Tomó la grasa: la cola grasa, toda la grasa que cubría las vísceras, el lóbulo largo del hígado, los dos riñones con su grasa, y también el muslo derecho.
es.R: Tomó las partes de grasa: la cola grasa, toda la grasa que había sobre los órganos internos, la mejor parte del hígado y los dos riñones con su grasa. También tomó el muslo derecho.

fr.L: Et il prit la graisse, et la queue grasse, et toute la graisse qui [était] sur les entrailles, et l’appendice du foie, et les deux rognons et leur graisse, et la cuisse droite.
fr.B: Il prit la graisse : la queue grasse, toute la graisse qui était sur les viscères, le grand lobe du foie, les deux rognons avec leur graisse, et aussi la cuisse droite.
fr.R: Il a pris les parties grasses : la queue grasse, toute la graisse qui était sur les organes du ventre, la meilleure partie du foie et les deux rognons avec leur graisse. Il a aussi pris la cuisse droite.

sw.L: Akaichukua shahamu, na mkia mnono, na shahamu yote iliyokuwa juu ya matumbo, na kipande kinachojitokeza cha ini, na figo mbili na shahamu yake, na paja la kulia.
sw.B: Alichukua shahamu: mkia mnono, shahamu yote iliyokuwa juu ya viungo vya ndani, kipande kirefu cha ini, figo mbili pamoja na shahamu yake, na pia paja la kulia.
sw.R: Alichukua sehemu zenye shahamu: mkia mnono, shahamu yote iliyokuwa juu ya viungo vya ndani, sehemu bora ya ini, na figo mbili pamoja na shahamu yake. Akachukua pia paja la kulia.

decisions.choice: the fat, the fat tail ... and the right thigh: the ram treated like a peace offering
decisions.reason: The fat parts are those of a sheep offered as a peace offering (3:9-10); the fat tail is the broad tail of the sheep (3:9). The right thigh is normally the priest's share of a peace offering (7:32-33). Here, at the ordination, it is not eaten by a priest but burned on the altar (verse 28; Exodus 29:22-25).

decisions.choice: He took the fat: the fat tail ...
decisions.reason: Balanced reads the first "the fat" as a heading for the fat parts that follow. Literal keeps the plain list.

source.text: וּמִסַּ֨ל הַמַּצּ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָ֠קַח חַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ עַל־הַ֣חֲלָבִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: And from [the] basket of the unleavened [bread] which [was] before Yahweh he took one cake of unleavened [bread] and one cake of bread [with] oil and one wafer, and placed [them] on the fat [pieces] and on the thigh the right.

en.L: And from the basket of unleavened [bread] that [was] before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of bread [made with] oil, and one wafer, and placed [them] on the fat [pieces] and on the right thigh.
en.B: From the basket of bread made without yeast that stood before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} he took one loaf made without yeast, one loaf made with oil, and one wafer, and laid them on the fat portions and on the right thigh.
en.R: There was a basket of bread made without yeast in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. From it he took one loaf, one loaf made with oil, and one thin wafer. He put them on top of the fat parts and the right thigh.

es.L: Y del canastillo de los [panes] sin levadura que [estaba] delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tomó una torta sin levadura, y una torta de pan [hecha con] aceite, y una oblea, y [las] puso sobre las [porciones de] grasa y sobre el muslo derecho.
es.B: Del canastillo de pan sin levadura que estaba delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tomó un pan sin levadura, un pan hecho con aceite y una oblea, y los colocó sobre las porciones de grasa y sobre el muslo derecho.
es.R: Delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había un canastillo de pan hecho sin levadura. De él tomó un pan, un pan hecho con aceite y una oblea delgada. Los puso encima de las partes de grasa y del muslo derecho.

fr.L: Et de la corbeille des [pains] sans levain qui [était] devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il prit un gâteau sans levain, et un gâteau de pain [fait à] l’huile, et une galette, et il [les] plaça sur les [morceaux de] graisse et sur la cuisse droite.
fr.B: Dans la corbeille de pain sans levain qui se trouvait devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il prit un pain sans levain, un pain fait à l’huile et une galette, et il les posa sur les morceaux de graisse et sur la cuisse droite.
fr.R: Il y avait devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} une corbeille de pain fait sans levain. Il y a pris un pain, un pain fait avec de l’huile et une fine galette. Il les a mis sur les parties grasses et sur la cuisse droite.

sw.L: Na kutoka katika kikapu cha [mikate] isiyotiwa chachu kilichokuwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akachukua mkate mmoja usiotiwa chachu, na mkate mmoja [uliotengenezwa kwa] mafuta, na mkate mwembamba mmoja, akaiweka juu ya [vipande vya] shahamu na juu ya paja la kulia.
sw.B: Kutoka katika kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu kilichokuwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alichukua mkate mmoja usiotiwa chachu, mkate mmoja uliokandwa kwa mafuta na mkate mwembamba mmoja, akaiweka juu ya vipande vya shahamu na juu ya paja la kulia.
sw.R: Mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kulikuwa na kikapu cha mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu. Kutoka humo alichukua mkate mmoja, mkate mmoja uliotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mwembamba mmoja. Akaiweka juu ya sehemu zenye shahamu na juu ya paja la kulia.

decisions.choice: one cake, one cake with oil, one wafer: one of each kind of bread in the basket
decisions.reason: Exodus 29:2-3, 23 describes the basket's three kinds of bread, all made of fine flour without yeast: plain loaves, loaves mixed with oil, and wafers spread with oil. Compare the baked grain offerings of 2:4.

decisions.choice: [made with] oil
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "bread of oil", meaning bread made with oil (Exodus 29:23).

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת־הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיָּ֧נֶף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And put the all on [the] palms of Aaron and on [the] palms of his sons, and waved them [as] a wave offering before Yahweh.

en.L: And he put it all on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and waved them [as] a wave offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He put all of this in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering.
en.R: He put all these things in the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then he waved them before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering.

es.L: Y lo puso todo sobre las palmas de Aarón y sobre las palmas de sus hijos, y los meció [como] ofrenda mecida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Puso todo esto en las manos de Aarón y de sus hijos, y lo meció delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida.
es.R: Puso todas estas cosas en las manos de Aarón y de sus hijos. Luego las meció delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida.

fr.L: Et il mit le tout sur les paumes d’Aaron et sur les paumes de ses fils, et il les balança [en] offrande balancée devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il plaça tout cela dans les mains d’Aaron et de ses fils, et le balança devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en offrande balancée.
fr.R: Il a mis toutes ces choses dans les mains d’Aaron et de ses fils. Puis il les a balancées devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme offrande balancée.

sw.L: Akaviweka vyote juu ya viganja vya Haruni na juu ya viganja vya wanawe, akavitikisa [kuwa] sadaka ya kutikiswa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Aliviweka vyote hivyo mikononi mwa Haruni na wanawe, akavitikisa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa sadaka ya kutikiswa.
sw.R: Aliviweka vitu hivyo vyote mikononi mwa Haruni na wanawe. Kisha akavitikisa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama sadaka ya kutikiswa.

decisions.choice: on the palms of Aaron and his sons: the hands are filled
decisions.reason: This act fits the meaning of ordination as "filling the hand" (verse 22): the priests' hands are filled with the gifts they will offer. For the wave offering see 7:30.

decisions.choice: he waved them: Moses, with the gifts in the priests' hands
decisions.reason: The subject is most likely Moses, as in verse 28, perhaps holding the priests' hands from beneath as they held the gifts. Exodus 29:24 says the gifts are put in their hands and "you will wave them".

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֹתָם֙ מֵעַ֣ל כַּפֵּיהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־הָעֹלָ֑ה מִלֻּאִ֥ים הֵם֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Moses them from on their palms and made [them] smoke on the altar on the burnt offering; ordination [offerings] they [were], for an aroma of soothing; an offering by fire it [was] to Yahweh.

en.L: And Moses took them from their palms and turned [them] into smoke on the altar, on top of the burnt offering. They [were] ordination [offerings], for an aroma of soothing; it [was] an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then Moses took them back from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering. They were an ordination offering with a soothing aroma, a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then Moses took these things from their hands. He burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering. This was the offering for ordaining the priests. Its smell pleased {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It was a food offering burned on the fire for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y los tomó Moisés de sus palmas, y [los] hizo humear sobre el altar, encima del holocausto. [Eran ofrendas de] investidura, de aroma grato; [era] una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Después Moisés los tomó de sus manos y los hizo subir en humo sobre el altar, encima del holocausto. Eran una ofrenda de investidura de aroma grato, una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Luego Moisés tomó estas cosas de sus manos. Las quemó en el altar encima del holocausto. Era la ofrenda para investir a los sacerdotes. Su olor fue agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Era una ofrenda quemada en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Moïse les prit de leurs paumes, et il [les] fit fumer sur l’autel, par-dessus l’holocauste. C’[étaient des offrandes d’]investiture, d’odeur apaisante ; c’[était] une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Puis Moïse les reprit de leurs mains et les fit monter en fumée sur l’autel, par-dessus l’holocauste. Ce fut une offrande d’investiture d’odeur apaisante, une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ensuite, Moïse a repris ces choses de leurs mains. Il les a brûlées sur l’autel, par-dessus l’holocauste. C’était l’offrande pour investir les prêtres. Son odeur a plu {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. C’était une offrande brûlée sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Musa akavichukua kutoka katika viganja vyao, akavifukiza juu ya madhabahu, juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. [Zilikuwa sadaka za] kusimikwa, za harufu ya kupendeza; [ilikuwa] sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kisha Musa alivichukua tena kutoka mikononi mwao, akavifukiza juu ya madhabahu juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Ilikuwa sadaka ya kusimikwa yenye harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kisha Musa alivichukua vitu hivyo kutoka mikononi mwao. Akavichoma juu ya madhabahu, juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Hiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya kuwasimika makuhani. Harufu yake ilimpendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ilikuwa sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: ordination offerings: the offerings that install the priests
decisions.reason: The same word as in verse 22, "fillings". Here it names the offering as a whole. It is also listed among the offerings in 7:37.

decisions.choice: on the burnt offering: on top of the ram of verse 21
decisions.reason: The parts are laid on the burnt offering already burning on the altar, as Exodus 29:25 says.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הֶ֣חָזֶ֔ה וַיְנִיפֵ֥הוּ תְנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מֵאֵ֣יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֗ים לְמֹשֶׁ֤ה הָיָה֙ לְמָנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Moses the breast and waved it [as] a wave offering before Yahweh; from [the] ram of the ordination to Moses it was for a portion, just as commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And Moses took the breast and waved it [as] a wave offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. From the ram of ordination it was Moses' portion, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Moses took the breast and waved it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering. It was Moses' own share of the ram of ordination, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: Moses took the breast and waved it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering. This was Moses' share of the ram for ordaining the priests. It was just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him.

es.L: Y tomó Moisés el pecho, y lo meció [como] ofrenda mecida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Del carnero de la investidura fue la porción de Moisés, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Moisés tomó el pecho y lo meció delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida. Era la parte del carnero de la investidura que le correspondía a Moisés, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Moisés tomó el pecho y lo meció delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida. Esa era la parte de Moisés del carnero para investir a los sacerdotes. Todo fue tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado.

fr.L: Et Moïse prit la poitrine, et il la balança [en] offrande balancée devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Du bélier de l’investiture, ce fut la part de Moïse, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Moïse prit la poitrine et la balança devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en offrande balancée. Ce fut la part du bélier de l’investiture qui revint à Moïse, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Moïse a pris la poitrine et l’a balancée devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme offrande balancée. C’était la part de Moïse dans le bélier pour investir les prêtres. Tout s’est passé comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait ordonné.

sw.L: Musa akakichukua kidari, akakitikisa [kuwa] sadaka ya kutikiswa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kutoka kwa kondoo dume wa kusimikwa kilikuwa fungu la Musa, kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Musa alikichukua kidari, akakitikisa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa sadaka ya kutikiswa. Hicho kilikuwa fungu la Musa mwenyewe kutoka kwa kondoo dume wa kusimikwa, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwagiza Musa.
sw.R: Musa alikichukua kidari, akakitikisa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama sadaka ya kutikiswa. Hicho kilikuwa fungu la Musa kutoka kwa kondoo dume wa kuwasimika makuhani. Ilikuwa sawasawa na vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru.

decisions.choice: the breast was Moses' portion: Moses acts as priest at the ordination
decisions.reason: Normally the breast of a peace offering belongs to the priests (7:30-31, 34). At this ordination Moses does the priest's work, so the breast is his share, as Exodus 29:26 commands. After this Aaron and his sons offer for themselves (9:1-24).

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֗ה וּמִן־הַדָּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֒ וַיַּ֤ז עַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְאֶת־בָּנָ֛יו וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Moses some of [the] oil of the anointing and some of the blood which [was] on the altar and sprinkled [it] on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons and on [the] garments of his sons with him, and consecrated Aaron, his garments, and his sons and [the] garments of his sons with him.

en.L: And Moses took some of the oil of anointing and some of the blood that [was] on the altar and sprinkled [it] on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him; and he consecrated Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
en.B: Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood on the altar and sprinkled it on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and their garments. In this way he consecrated Aaron and his garments, and his sons and their garments with him.
en.R: Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood from the altar. He sprinkled them on Aaron and his clothes, and on Aaron's sons and their clothes. In this way he set Aaron and his sons apart as holy, together with their clothes.

es.L: Y tomó Moisés del aceite de la unción y de la sangre que [estaba] sobre el altar, y [los] roció sobre Aarón, sobre sus vestiduras, y sobre sus hijos, y sobre las vestiduras de sus hijos con él; y consagró a Aarón, sus vestiduras, y a sus hijos, y las vestiduras de sus hijos con él.
es.B: Moisés tomó un poco del aceite de la unción y de la sangre que estaba sobre el altar, y los roció sobre Aarón y sus vestiduras, y sobre sus hijos y las vestiduras de ellos. Así consagró a Aarón y sus vestiduras, y con él a sus hijos y sus vestiduras.
es.R: Moisés tomó un poco del aceite de la unción y un poco de la sangre del altar. Los roció sobre Aarón y su ropa, y sobre los hijos de Aarón y su ropa. Así apartó como santos a Aarón y a sus hijos, junto con su ropa.

fr.L: Et Moïse prit de l’huile d’onction et du sang qui [était] sur l’autel, et il [en] aspergea Aaron, ses vêtements, et ses fils, et les vêtements de ses fils avec lui ; et il consacra Aaron, ses vêtements, et ses fils, et les vêtements de ses fils avec lui.
fr.B: Moïse prit un peu de l’huile d’onction et du sang qui était sur l’autel, et il en aspergea Aaron et ses vêtements, ainsi que ses fils et leurs vêtements. Il consacra ainsi Aaron et ses vêtements, et avec lui ses fils et leurs vêtements.
fr.R: Moïse a pris un peu d’huile d’onction et un peu de sang de l’autel. Il en a aspergé Aaron et ses vêtements, ainsi que les fils d’Aaron et leurs vêtements. Ainsi, il a mis à part comme saints Aaron et ses fils, avec leurs vêtements.

sw.L: Musa akachukua sehemu ya mafuta ya kupaka na sehemu ya damu iliyokuwa juu ya madhabahu, akanyunyiza juu ya Haruni, juu ya mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe, na juu ya mavazi ya wanawe pamoja naye; akamtakasa Haruni, mavazi yake, na wanawe, na mavazi ya wanawe pamoja naye.
sw.B: Musa alichukua kiasi cha mafuta ya kupaka na cha damu iliyokuwa juu ya madhabahu, akavinyunyiza juu ya Haruni na mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe na mavazi yao. Kwa njia hiyo akamtakasa Haruni na mavazi yake, na wanawe pamoja na mavazi yao.
sw.R: Musa alichukua mafuta kidogo ya kupaka na damu kidogo kutoka madhabahuni. Akavinyunyiza juu ya Haruni na mavazi yake, na juu ya wana wa Haruni na mavazi yao. Kwa njia hiyo akawatenga Haruni na wanawe kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na mavazi yao.

decisions.choice: oil and blood together: the priests are both cleansed and made holy
decisions.reason: Exodus 29:21 commands this sprinkling with both the oil and the blood from the altar. The blood from the altar joins the priests to the altar and its atonement, and the oil marks them as holy. Now the sons too are anointed (Exodus 28:41; 30:30; 40:15).

decisions.choice: consecrated: made holy
decisions.reason: As in verse 10. The garments too become holy, so that the priests' clothing is passed on to Aaron's successors at their own anointing (Exodus 29:29).

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו בַּשְּׁל֣וּ אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר֮ פֶּ֣תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֒ וְשָׁם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וְאֶ֨ת־הַלֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּסַ֣ל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוֵּ֨יתִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Moses to Aaron and to his sons, boil the meat [at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, and there you will eat it and the bread which [is] in [the] basket of the ordination, just as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons will eat it.

en.L: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, "Boil the meat at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and there you will eat it and the bread that [is] in the basket of the ordination [offerings], just as I commanded, saying, 'Aaron and his sons will eat it.'
en.B: Moses told Aaron and his sons, "Boil the meat at the entrance of the tent of meeting and eat it there, with the bread that is in the ordination basket, as I commanded when I said, 'Aaron and his sons are to eat it.'
en.R: Moses told Aaron and his sons, "Cook the meat at the entrance of the meeting tent. Eat it there with the bread from the basket for the ordination. That is what I commanded. I said, 'Aaron and his sons must eat it.'

es.L: Y dijo Moisés a Aarón y a sus hijos: «{{plural_you:Cuezan|Coced}} la carne a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, y allí la {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}}, y el pan que [está] en el canastillo de las [ofrendas de] investidura, tal como mandé, diciendo: “Aarón y sus hijos la comerán”.
es.B: Moisés les dijo a Aarón y a sus hijos: «{{plural_you:Cuezan|Coced}} la carne a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro y {{plural_you:cómanla|comedla}} allí, con el pan que está en el canastillo de la investidura, como mandé cuando dije: “Aarón y sus hijos deben comerla”.
es.R: Moisés les dijo a Aarón y a sus hijos: «{{plural_you:Cocinen|Cocinad}} la carne a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro. {{plural_you:Cómanla|Comedla}} allí con el pan del canastillo de la investidura. Eso es lo que mandé. Dije: “Aarón y sus hijos tienen que comerla”.

fr.L: Et Moïse dit à Aaron et à ses fils : « Faites bouillir la viande à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et là vous la mangerez, ainsi que le pain qui [est] dans la corbeille des [offrandes d’]investiture, comme je l’ai ordonné en disant : “Aaron et ses fils la mangeront.”
fr.B: Moïse dit à Aaron et à ses fils : « Faites bouillir la viande à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre et mangez-la là, avec le pain qui est dans la corbeille de l’investiture, comme je l’ai ordonné quand j’ai dit : “Aaron et ses fils doivent la manger.”
fr.R: Moïse a dit à Aaron et à ses fils : « Faites cuire la viande à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre. Mangez-la là, avec le pain de la corbeille de l’investiture. C’est ce que j’ai ordonné. J’ai dit : “Aaron et ses fils doivent la manger.”

sw.L: Musa akawaambia Haruni na wanawe, "Ichemsheni nyama penye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, na hapo mtaila, pamoja na mkate ulio katika kikapu cha [sadaka za] kusimikwa, kama vile nilivyoamuru, nikisema, 'Haruni na wanawe wataila.'
sw.B: Musa aliwaambia Haruni na wanawe, "Ichemsheni nyama kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania na kuila hapo, pamoja na mkate ulio katika kikapu cha kusimikwa, kama nilivyoamuru niliposema, 'Haruni na wanawe ndio watakaoila.'
sw.R: Musa aliwaambia Haruni na wanawe, "Pikeni nyama kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania. Ileni hapo pamoja na mkate wa kikapu cha kusimikwa. Ndivyo nilivyoamuru. Nilisema, 'Haruni na wanawe lazima waile.'

decisions.choice: boil the meat and eat it there: the priests eat the rest of the ram of ordination
decisions.reason: The rest of the ram, apart from the parts burned and Moses' breast, is eaten by Aaron and his sons in the holy place, near the tent, with the remaining bread (Exodus 29:31-33). As with a peace offering, those for whom the sacrifice was made share its meal (7:15).

decisions.choice: I commanded: as the Hebrew reads
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "I commanded": Moses refers to his own instruction, which repeated God's command. The Septuagint reads "as it was commanded to me", which matches verse 35, and the same consonants could be read "I was commanded".

decisions.choice: Cook
decisions.reason: Readable says "cook". The Hebrew word means to cook in water, to boil, which Literal and Balanced keep.

source.text: וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר בַּבָּשָׂ֖ר וּבַלָּ֑חֶם בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the remainder of the meat and of the bread with fire you will burn.

en.L: And what is left over of the meat and of the bread you will burn with fire.
en.B: Whatever is left of the meat and the bread you must burn up.
en.R: You must burn up any meat or bread that is left over.

es.L: Y lo que sobre de la carne y del pan lo {{plural_you:quemarán|quemaréis}} al fuego.
es.B: Lo que quede de la carne y del pan lo {{plural_you:quemarán|quemaréis}} por completo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que quemar toda la carne o el pan que sobre.

fr.L: Et ce qui restera de la viande et du pain, vous le brûlerez au feu.
fr.B: Ce qui restera de la viande et du pain, vous le brûlerez entièrement.
fr.R: Vous devez brûler toute la viande ou tout le pain qui reste.

sw.L: Na kitakachobaki cha nyama na cha mkate mtakiteketeza kwa moto.
sw.B: Chochote kitakachobaki cha nyama na mkate, mkiteketeze kabisa kwa moto.
sw.R: Lazima mchome nyama yoyote au mkate wowote utakaobaki.

decisions.choice: burn what is left: holy food may not be kept
decisions.reason: As Exodus 29:34 commands, what is not eaten is burned, not kept until later, "because it is holy". Compare the rule for the thanksgiving offering in 7:15-17.

source.text: וּמִפֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים עַ֚ד י֣וֹם מְלֹ֔את יְמֵ֖י מִלֻּאֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת־יֶדְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And from [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting not you will go out [for] seven days, until [the] day [the] days of your ordination are complete, for seven days he will fill your hand.

en.L: And from the entrance of the tent of meeting you will not go out [for] seven days, until the day the days of your ordination are completed; for seven days he will fill your hand.
en.B: Stay at the entrance of the tent of meeting and do not leave it for seven days, until the time of your ordination is over. It will take seven days for you to be ordained.
en.R: Do not leave the entrance of the meeting tent for seven days. Stay until the days for making you priests are over. It will take seven days to make you priests.

es.L: Y de la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro no {{plural_you:saldrán|saldréis}} [durante] siete días, hasta el día en que se cumplan los días de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} investidura; porque durante siete días llenará {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mano.
es.B: {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro y no {{plural_you:salgan|salgáis}} de allí durante siete días, hasta que termine el tiempo de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} investidura. {{plural_you:Su|Vuestra}} investidura durará siete días.
es.R: No {{plural_you:salgan|salgáis}} de la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro durante siete días. {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} allí hasta que terminen los días para {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} sacerdotes. Se necesitan siete días para {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et de l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre vous ne sortirez pas [pendant] sept jours, jusqu’au jour où seront accomplis les jours de votre investiture ; car pendant sept jours il remplira votre main.
